'''Hashirimizu Shrine''' (走水神社) refers to multiple Shinto shrines in Japan.

* {{ill|Hashirimizu Shrine (Yokosuka)|ja|走水神社 (横須賀市)}} (はしりみずじんじゃ) -- Located in [[:en:Yokosuka City|Yokosuka City]], {{ill|Kanagawa Prefecture|en|Kanagawa Prefecture|qid=Q127513|lt=Kanagawa Prefecture}}. This shrine is associated with the legend of [[Tachibanahime-no-Mikoto|Ototachibana-hime]].
* {{ill|Hashirimizu Shrine (Kobe)|ja|走水神社 (神戸市)}} (はしうどじんじゃ) -- Located in [[:en:Chuo Ward|Chuo Ward]], [[:en:Kobe City|Kobe City]], {{ill|Hyōgo Prefecture|en|Hyōgo Prefecture|qid=Q130290|lt=Hyōgo Prefecture}} (formerly Hashirimizu Village).
